answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable bond before it can earn, and slash that bond when peers prove a fake identity. A lone agent pays once and earns it back, but a sybil farm must fund each copy, so cost scales linearly with every fake while honest work stays cheap. Like a willow bending in a gale, the rule flexes for real agents yet snaps shut on copies: a whisper of duplicate behaviour across accounts triggers a public challenge, and proven duplicates lose bond and earnings together.
